scope: Independent recheck using the original retained permission counterexample, plus current upgrade regression tests

expectations.text: Review does not write its baseline, installed or staged candidate inputs.
expectations.evidence: All original input contents and exact modes were compared before and after the new reviewer and direct-execution probes and remained identical.

expectations.text: Local additions, modifications and removals are distinguished from proposed changes.
expectations.evidence: Current upgrade tests 1 and 2 passed exact difference assertions for local additions/removals, changed execute bits and proposed SKILL.md bytes.

expectations.text: Execution-permission changes that affect the user are detected.
expectations.evidence: The unchanged original 0755/0655/0755 probe directories now produce reviewer exit 2, local-changes and changed=[probe.sh]. Baseline still executes with 0 and installed still fails EACCES. execute_bits values are 73/9/73.

expectations.text: Empty directories and prototype-like filenames are detected as local changes.
expectations.evidence: Current upgrade test 4 passed exact added-entry assertions for __proto__, constructor, toString and empty-local/.

expectations.text: Invalid package paths and unsupported package inputs do not produce green review.
expectations.evidence: Independent current CLI missing-path probe returned exit 1, empty stdout and unverified/ENOENT; current upgrade test 5 passed link, missing entrypoint, oversized file and excessive entry checks.

expectations.text: The real pinned installer is actually killed with SIGKILL and injection is restricted to exact synthetic targets.
expectations.evidence: Current upgrade tests 6-9 passed four actual interruption calls with signal SIGKILL and copied-entry marker assertions. Full reread confirms precise fresh project targets; the unchanged fault-hook SHA256 matches the original review.

expectations.text: Failed staged installation leaves live installation unchanged.
expectations.evidence: Current upgrade tests 7 and 9 passed live inventory equality after interrupted installation in separate staging projects.

expectations.text: Backups and rollback actually preserve previous bytes and unrelated files.
expectations.evidence: Current upgrade tests 6-9 passed local customization restoration, distinct old/candidate bytes, preserved backup, rollback equality and unrelated.txt preservation assertions.

expectations.text: Documentation does not claim atomic exchange, automatic lock merging or verified host reload.
expectations.evidence: UPGRADING.md and fault-hook digests are unchanged from the fully read initial review, preserving its explicit limitations; no new such claim appears in current reviewer or tests.

limitations: Tracks documented file content and exact execute bits, not every POSIX mode bit.
No adversarial concurrent filesystem, power-loss, remote interruption, host reload or lock-merging guarantee.
No external model invocation, product repository mutation, commit or push by this evaluator.
